title: Magic: The Gathering Miniatures: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms

paragraphs.text: Magic: The Gathering Miniatures is a line of pre-painted miniatures produced by WizKids , created as a supplement for the Dungeons & Dragons tabletop roleplaying game. They were released on February 15, 2022.

When Magic: The Gathering and D&D made their first official crossover card set with the Adventures in the Forgotten Realms , Wizkids joined in with two Starter Sets of miniatures especially created for the Forgotten Realms campaign setting . Each Starter Set will retail for $49.99. The Starter Sets each contain five figures for your adventures

Confusingly, these sets are marketed as Magic: The Gathering Miniatures , but only show characters of the D&D IP. Ellywick Tumblestrum , Nadaar, Varis, Hama Pashar are characters especially created for Adventures in the Forgotten Realms.
The Companions of the Hall Starter comes with Drizzt Do'Urden , Catti-brie , Wulfgar , Bruenor Battlehammer , and Guenhwyvar . Item Code: WZK96109.
The Adventuring Party Starter showcases Tumblestrum, Nadaar, Varis, Hama Pashar , and a Yuan-ti Rogue. Item Code: WZK96110.

WizKids also released Lolth , the Spider Queen, as a premium figure. It is a fully-painted premium figure of this chaotic evil goddess. It is about five-inches tall, and towers over any hero willing to stand in her presence. This figure comes one per master carton and retailed for $69.99. Item Code: WZK96111.
